title: bilstmLayer
summary: Create a bidirectional LSTM layer compatibility object.
description: `bilstmLayer(numHiddenUnits)` creates metadata for bidirectional LSTM layers.
behaviors: `OutputMode` defaults to `last` and can be overridden with a name-value option.
Common recurrent-layer options are preserved as properties.

example.input:
layer = bilstmLayer(numHiddenUnits)
layer = bilstmLayer(numHiddenUnits, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Layer construction is host metadata work and has no provider kernel.
